Dialogs.Dialog: I just had a haircut. What do you think？
I just had a haircut. Do I look okay？
I tried a slightly different look with my hair. What do you think？
I changed my hair length. What do you think？
I couldn't decide on the length of my hair, so it ended up semi-long. Do I look weird？
I'm trying this hairstyle. How is it？
I grew my hair out. What do you think？
A magazine said guys like long hair... Don't tell me I fell for it？
I figured long hair might be better after all. What do you think？
I knew it. I thought you'd say that.
Getting complimented makes me shy. It's embarrassing, so don't look too much.
I'm glad you like it. I don't know what I'd do if you said you didn't like it.
Really？ I thought you'd like it though.
I'm glad you told me honestly, but... No... It's okay. Thank you for being honest.
Huh, really？ It's no good？ That's disappointing...
How about this？ It's my new hairstyle.
I changed my hairstyle. ...Does it look strange？
I changed my hairstyle. How is it？
Hehe, I'm glad. It's good that I decided on this.
Good. I was hoping it would make you happy.
Huh, no way. It's no good...
I thought I should change my image, so...
I tried a slightly different look with my hair. What do you think？
How's this？ I kind of think I might have overdone it...
It's really embarrassing, but how about... this？
I gave it a shot, but is it too much？ Not very ladylike？
I was thinking of changing up my clothes a little.
I wanted to change my image a little bit... I hope you like it.
I've been thinking about what kinds of clothes you would like best...
I went for a clean look. What do you think？
I figured you don't like anything too fussy, so I went simple... Does it suit me？
I went for a neat, innocent look. I hope it worked.
I tried to play up my feminine side. How is it？
I went for a girly look...
I picked out girly clothes. I hope I look cute.
I dropped the stiff look and tried this. What do you think？
I tried to look more approachable. Is it, um, weird？
I went casual. What do you think... do you like it？
How's this？ I kind of think I might have overdone it...
It's really embarrassing, but how about... this？
I gave it a shot, but is it too much？ Not very ladylike？
Yeah, good. Then maybe I'll dress like this for a while.
I'm so glad... I was wondering what I should do if you said it didn't suit me.
I'm so happy！ I changed it for you, hehe.
I see. Too bad. I didn't think it was that bad.
Huh, really!? Sorry, I'll try harder.
Huh, really？ ...But I'm glad you were honest. That must have been hard to say. Thanks.
Feels like you don't really care. Fine, though.
Hey... can't you say anything else？ Geez.
Geez, and I tried so hard...
...I thought you'd at least say something.
I was thinking of changing my clothes. Would a different style be better？
Today, I tried to go for a simple look... What do you think？
You don't seem to like flashy things, so I picked something plain again today. Well, do you like it？
Lately I've been dressing girly. Honestly, what do you think？
Sorry... it's the same kind of outfit as always... Would you like another style？
Lately I like cute stuff like this. What do you think？ Tell me, as my boyfriend？
It's easy to move in casual clothes but... I wonder if they hide my girlishness. What do you think？
Casual clothes make me look a little frivolous, don't they... Should I change？
What do you think of this kind of casual clothing？
Good... But I need to try even harder.
Really？ Good. I know everything about you, after all. Hehe, just kidding.
Ah, really. I wonder if it's about time to do an image change.
Really... I'm sorry. Next time I'll think harder before choosing.
Eh？ Really？ I see. I thought I understood your tastes, though...
I see. I guess boys aren't interested in clothes.
Mm... that doesn't really tell me anything...
Geez, are you shy, by any chance？
